FIELDS.NAME: Grace Community Church
FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Smith, Facilities Manager, Grace Community Church, Phone: (555) 123-4567, Email: johndoe@gracecommunitychurch.org
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Grace Community Church operates as a religious organization focused on providing spiritual guidance and community support. Our core operations include weekly worship services, educational programs for all ages, and various community outreach initiatives aimed at helping those in need. We maintain an active calendar of events, including Bible study groups, youth programs, and volunteer opportunities, fostering a welcoming and inclusive environment for individuals and families. Our facilities are regularly maintained to ensure safety and compliance with local codes, reflecting our commitment to creating a safe space for worship and community gatherings. We prioritize the well-being of our congregation by implementing background checks for all staff and volunteers, particularly those working with children, and have established child protection policies to safeguard against risks. We are dedicated to contributing positively to the local community while advancing our mission of faith and service.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Community Thrift Store - A nonprofit retail operation supporting church outreach programs by selling donated items.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 15, 2022, a minor water leak caused damage to the ceiling in our fellowship hall, resulting in repair costs of $1,500. The issue has been fully resolved and the repairs were completed by a licensed contractor. Status: Closed.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 9 AM - 5 PM; Saturday: 10 AM - 4 PM; Sunday: 8 AM - 1 PM
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Fire-resistant safe, Class B, UL Listed
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Fencing and regular patrols by volunteer safety teams
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – Grace Community Church does not engage in storing, treating, discharging, applying, disposing, or transporting hazardous materials in its operations. The church focuses on community service and worship activities without involvement in such operations.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – Grace Community Church does not sponsor athletic teams, as its focus is primarily on spiritual guidance and community support through various programs and activities.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Subcontractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance, as this ensures proper risk transfer. The designated individual, typically a compliance officer or project manager, is responsible for checking these certificates.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – There have been no indictments or convictions for fraud, bribery, arson, or any arson-related crimes associated with Grace Community Church or its applicants. The organization is committed to maintaining high ethical standards and compliance in all its operations.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – Grace Community Church has not had any policy or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed during the prior three years. We maintain a good standing with our previous carrier and ensure compliance with all required regulations.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Grace Community Church does not lease employees to or from other employers. The church employs its own staff directly to support its operations and community programs.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – Grace Community Church currently carries Workers' Compensation insurance to ensure compliance with legal requirements and protect its employees. The church prioritizes the well-being of its staff and operates with proper coverage in place.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: Yes – Grace Community Church operates a Community Thrift Store, which is a nonprofit retail operation supporting church outreach programs by selling donated items. This initiative helps fund various community services and maintain the church's mission.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Grace Community Church does not have any other insurance policies with this company at this time. Our current policy is the only coverage currently in effect.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Grace Community Church is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. Our activities primarily focus on providing spiritual guidance and community support through various programs and services.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Grace Community Church does not rent or loan equipment to others, as our operations focus primarily on providing spiritual guidance and community support rather than equipment sharing.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Grace Community Church has not had any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years. The church maintains a stable financial position and adheres to responsible financial practices.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Grace Community Church does not have exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals as our operations focus on providing spiritual guidance and community support with no involvement in related activities.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Grace Community Church does not have any known catastrophe exposure as its operations are centered on community service and worship activities without high-risk activities. The church maintains compliance with safety regulations to minimize any potential risks.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Grace Community Church has not had any past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. The church has implemented policies to ensure the safety and protection of its congregation and community.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Grace Community Church has no uncorrected fire code violations. The church regularly maintains its facilities to ensure compliance with all safety regulations.
